title: Score on the PRD view
summary: The PRD tab now shows each version's score out of 10, with marks and comments per quality criterion and per section, score badges in the version list, and a Rerun button that starts /grillo-score on the latest version.

deferred.what: One malformed v<n>.score.json (not JSON or missing a field, e.g. written badly by the /grillo-score agent) makes listPrdVersions reject, so the whole PRD view shows only an error and its Rerun button is unreachable until the file is fixed by hand.
deferred.why: Outside this story's seam (the store); the score panel only handles out-of-range marks and empty names.
